tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm paper by Day, the shed at Night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, pail rows, inputs, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Command blocks, build logs, the idle drop zone — anything you read rather than click.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and drop-zone borders: ≥3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk, pail-soft and water-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: URLs under a pail name, timestamps, hints. Legible (≥5.4:1) on every surface and the soft tints.

tokens.name: pail
tokens.usage: The brand: the sunny paint on the pail. Fill of the primary button, the fill in the mark, the "building" dot. A fill, never text on light grounds (1.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: on-pail
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pail fill (the primary button label). Never white.

tokens.name: pail-ink
tokens.usage: Pail yellow as text: the "Building" label, step lines in logs. On surface, surface-raised and pail-soft.

tokens.name: pail-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind pail-ink: the Building status pill, the drop zone while a file hovers.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Water blue. Decorative fill only (the cover, illustrations); no text on it in Night.

tokens.name: water-ink
tokens.usage: Links and URLs you can click; the focus ring. On surface, surface-raised and water-soft.

tokens.name: water-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind water-ink: the selected source tile, info notes.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: "Live" status text and dot. Always with the word Live; on surface, surface-raised and live-soft.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Live status pill.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: "Failed" status, error text, danger button fill. Always with a word; on surface, surface-raised and failed-soft.

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Failed pill and error notes.

tokens.name: on-failed
tokens.usage: Text on a failed fill (the danger button).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — an alias of water-ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour — an alias of water-ink; ≥5.8:1 on every surface in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, bold. Pail names and page titles only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A pail’s name on its own page; dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and pail names in lists.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk for everything you read.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop a folder or a .zip and it’s live in a few seconds.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for anything you could type or paste: commands, URLs, hashes, logs.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline URLs, commit hashes, build logs.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous: Pail shows a few things at a time.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; between stacked label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; button vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and row padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a card; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the page title; around empty states.

radius.note: Softly squared, like a pressed-steel rim. Pills only for status.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, command blocks, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, pail rows, cards, the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the outer page card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills and dots only.

shadow.note: Flat by default; borders do the work. One lift for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Rows and cards at rest — a single 1px bottom edge.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, the toast.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid water-ink.
